title: Monotone bounded influence learner
statement: For each dimension $n\in\mathbb{N}$, positive rational influence bound $t$, and rational accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$ with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, this defines a random-example learning program whose output is a sparse Fourier hypothesis on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, by combining the bounded-influence second stage with the monotone influence-selection program.
